description: Run code in Lizard Sandboxes and manage apps on Lizard (lizard.build). Includes 56 tools for sandbox files and commands, deployments, managed databases, logs, metrics, secrets and domains.

notes: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and discovery is supported. Clients that set headers may use their own Lizard API key as a Bearer token.
Tool count and remote setup were submitted by the maintainer in issue #3922. The seven listed names are the newly added sandbox tools, not the complete 56-tool list.
